parsed.title: plan-feature:scaffold ceiling raised without a sources entry, contradicting the sibling pattern
parsed.detail: The diff raises plan-feature:scaffold routeEstimateMax 8934→9077 and routeLinesMax 729→739, but the tip content shows no "sources" key for plan-feature:scaffold, while every other route touched by this unit (plan-feature:issue, plan-feature:scoped, plan-fix:issue, review-change:*) gained a "sources": {"fix 224 / #224": "... ceiling = ceil(measured x 1.10)"} entry. The declared rule visible in this material is that a ceiling change is accompanied by a source receipt; scaffold's bump is unreceipted.

parsed.title: plan-feature:scaffold ceiling does not match the stated ceil(measured x 1.10) rule
parsed.detail: The unit's own sources text states "ceiling = ceil(measured x 1.10)". For plan-feature:scaffold the new ceiling is 9077 est / 739 lines. If the prior 8934/729 were the measured values, ceil(8934*1.10)=9828 and ceil(729*1.10)=802, not 9077/739. The bump is ~1.6% est and ~1.4% lines, inconsistent with the 10% headroom rule the unit declares for the same change.

parsed.title: plan-feature:scaffold ceiling raised but no skill surface in this slice justifies it
parsed.detail: The unit's stated purpose is "replan destination convergence across the skill surfaces". plan-feature:scaffold's skill list (plan-feature-scaffold, phase-contract, verification-contract, evidence-grounding, pre-execution-review) is unchanged in the diff, and no replan-findings skill is added to that route, yet its ceiling grows. Either the route should include replan-findings (like other replan-converged routes) or the ceiling change is unexplained.

parsed.title: replan-findings budget entry has no ceiling, only a prose source
parsed.detail: The new replan-findings block adds only "referenceSources" with prose ("measured within the default reference budget") and no referenceEstimateMax/referenceLinesMax. Every other skill entry that carries a referenceSources also carries an explicit referenceEstimateMax (review-change 2800, workflow-status 2300, pre-execution-review 3557). Relying on the default 2200 while claiming a measurement is a receipt that cannot be checked against a recorded number.

parsed.title: workflow-status referenceEstimateMax raised to 2300 but measured value 2297 leaves <0.2% headroom
parsed.detail: The source text says "measured 2297 est" and the ceiling is set to 2300. The unit's own rule for route ceilings is "ceil(measured x 1.10)"; applying the same 10% headroom to 2297 would give 2527. A 3-est margin is below the declared headroom policy and will trip on any minor edit.

parsed.title: Plugin manifest does not list the new replan-findings skill
parsed.detail: The unit adds a replan-findings skill (referenced in SKILL_CONTEXT_BUDGETS.json as "replan-findings": {...} and described as "conditional replan entry"), but .claude-plugin/plugin.json's skills array (unchanged by the unit) contains no "./skills/replan-findings" entry. The skill is budgeted and routed but not registered in the plugin manifest, so it will not be loaded by the plugin.
